lines.text: If it's too hot, be sure to tell me. Summertime is when you're most at risk for heat stroke.
I get to see the ocean thanks to you.
This is so relaxing!
Since you barely have any clothes on, it'll make giving a physical exam much simpler, haha!
I'll rub some sunscreen on you later. Otherwise, you'll get burned if you stay out in the sun.
The sun's shining awfully bright today. Actually, it reminds me of you, Commander.
You haven't swam in the ocean yet, have you? I can't swim, so I won't be able to save you if you fall in.
There's nothing wrong with playing in the water, but just be careful so you don't end up drowning. If anything happened to you, I'd never be able to forgive myself.
That day was so much fun!
Maybe the next time, we can go, just the two of us. I can be your personal attending physician, hehe.
I look forward to our next vacation.
Playing in the water is fun and all, but be careful not to tire yourself out.
I'll be able to give you a more thorough examination next time, hehe!
Now my physical fortitude is as strong as my mental fortitude!
You've got to catch up, Commander. I'm the only one getting stronger.
Oh, thank you! This may come in handy during your next physical.
You're so kind, Commander.
I'll take good care of this.
It seems kind of hot in here... Maybe that's just because it's summer?
In theory, I should treat every patient the exact same, but I do show you some special treatment from time to time.
I'm a bit concerned, hehe, because I can't stop thinking about you.
Do you need help?
Yes? What is it?
Coming! Hehe.
Oh dear, there isn't much time to rest, is there?
Everyone, gather 'round.
I've got a special inoculation prepared for this.
This'll only hurt a bit, hehe.
Wait a moment, please.
I'll be back in a jiffy.
Reloading.
Commander?
Just a little closer...
Pain, be gone!
Next patient.
Heheheh...
Invasive pathogens exterminated.
Ugh...!
Errggh!
*Gasp*
Sorry, but I'll have to bow out early.
If you're hurt anywhere, come find me.
